title: Email-auth test site pages (/join, /verify, /signin)
acceptance_criteria: Server-rendered pages for /join (sign-up), /verify (enter code / landing for link), /signin (login), and a post-login profile/success page
Forms have real labels, input types and autocomplete attrs so the agent's semantic discovery is genuinely exercised (not reliant on conventional route names)
Pages wire to the Express endpoints from the server ticket; clear visible success/error states
